duration.to: Initial emergency moratorium to 2026-03-18; revised to 2026-04-08; extended to 2026-10-07; Resolution R-100626A adopted October 6, 2026 extends to December 16, 2026, unless an additional moratorium is approved after a public hearing or the Board terminates it earlier.

current_status.from: Active as of 2026-09-23; Resolution R-040726b (adopted 2026-04-07) bars data center applications until 2026-10-07. No further extension or adopted data center ordinance was found as of this pass.
current_status.to: Extended by Resolution R-100626A: the October 6, 2026 official BOC minutes reproduce the resolution and record adoption 5-0 following a public hearing. Section 2 bars data-center development applications until December 16, 2026; section 4 provides earlier termination upon approval of an additional moratorium after a public hearing or Board action terminating the moratorium; section 5 makes it effective upon a majority vote. Later action has not been comprehensively excluded by this targeted review as of 2026-11-06.
current_status.reason: Official October 6 minutes reproduce R-100626A, including December 16 outer endpoint, earlier-action triggers, immediate majority-vote effect and adoption 5-0.

outcome.to: Resolution R-100626A adopted 5-0 on October 6, 2026, extending the moratorium while the County studies, develops and considers a data-center ordinance.
outcome.reason: Official October 6 minutes reproduce R-100626A, including December 16 outer endpoint, earlier-action triggers, immediate majority-vote effect and adoption 5-0.

evidence.supports: Resolution R-100626A sections 2, 4 and 5 and recorded 5-0 adoption following public hearing; replaces obsolete October 7 endpoint.
evidence.quote: The moratorium imposed by this Resolution shall terminate on the earliest date of (1) December 16, 2026; (2) approval by the Board of an additional moratorium after a public hearing; or (3) Board action terminating the moratorium;

decisions.notes: Retain extended classification. This is proof of the October 6 extension, not an exhaustive later-action check or a claim that permanent regulations have been adopted.
